header.elements: exactly one positive safe-integer vertex count; no other element even at count zero
header.ignored: empty header lines and printable ASCII comment / obj_info lines; never interpret a URL
header.terminator: standalone end_header line, anchored to a line boundary
header.directives: format exactly once; vertex element exactly once; properties after that element in listed order; only blank/comment/obj_info lines otherwise; no other directive

payload.fields: exactly six space/tab separated decimal tokens per declared row; no GS/face/normal/alpha/list data
payload.positions: finite decimal Number -> IEEE754 Float32 round-to-nearest ties-to-even -> require finite -> normalize negative zero
payload.rgb: unsigned decimal integer 0..255 -> channel/255 sRGB -> linear channel by 01 section4.2 -> IEEE754 Float32
payload.budgets: original byteLength <= existing maxFileBytes, pointCount <= maxItems, 6*pointCount <= maxValues; reject before unbounded allocation

frame.axis: preserve original XYZ as right-handed Y-up AssetFrame coordinates
frame.unit: one source coordinate unit is one Asset metre; no inferred units or recentering

bounds: exact component-wise min/max of all post-Float32 positions, canonical positive zeros; point-centre geometric support, screen glyph footprint remains transient

occurrence.pointIndex: original zero-based row ordinal; retain duplicates; no LOD/reorder

records.materialCatalog: one synthetic slot; vertex RGB contribution preserved

decodeVerification: pinned loader output count=N, no triangles, exact ordinal positions and linear colors, finite arrays, exact bounds/catalog; mismatch fails rather than rewriting metadata
